mentions.name: Groebner basis routines (F4 and FGLM)
mentions.description: Public domain code implementing the F4 and FGLM algorithms for computing Groebner bases, released in the hope that other systems will adopt the routines.
mentions.source_excerpt: I released some public domain code for computing Groebner bases (F4 and FGLM).  I'm hoping these routines will find their way into more systems.
